text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japanese Oaks, and Nishino Flower's weight…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's gone back to normal! Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I wasn't able to do the training regimen you initially made for me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true she might not be in the condition we were shooting for, but she's done everything she could. And now…
choice_data_list: You just have to run with all your might and leave no regrets behind!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I have no idea how well she'll be able to perform in a medium-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she debuted early, she's younger than the other racers. Her small size puts her at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Plus, her running style for medium distance isn't the same one Sakura Bakushin O and Yamanin Zephyr praised before the Oka Sho. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You can never tell what will happen in a race. All I can do is watch and believe in all of the work we've put in.
